summary: Iteration 2 tested end to end: photo uploads (Emergent object storage), guest list (one-by-one, paste with review/edit/remove, CSV, VCF, contacts fallback, event chips, WhatsApp hrefs with g=, copy, inline edit, delete confirm, search, CSV export, send-to-all queue through to the done state), opened tracking with event-switcher filtering, Send your wishes (validation, suggestions, wa.me href, success message, host wishes-list), en/hi/ur languages (wizard title and event swap, RTL preview, Hindi intro text, Urdu public card with photos, OG for Urdu), the 7-step wizard publish/edit with photos, and regressions (Royal and Birthday intros, countdown, directions, calendar, switcher, replay, OTP login, link maker, no horizontal scroll at 390px). Backend: 27/27 pytest passed. Frontend: all requested flows passed. Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: An unknown guest_id returns 200 (sent returns null, delete returns ok) instead of 404.
An invalid phone (e.g. '123') is silently stored as '' with no 422. The edit also skips the dedupe check, so it can create a duplicate phone.
It trusts the client's content-type and doesn't check the file's magic bytes. check_photos only checks the path prefix, not that the file exists in db.files.
No rate limit or dedupe. Every click on the WhatsApp button saves a new wish, so double taps create duplicates.

ui_bugs.issue: The button label is still 'Share & RSVPs' (en.js common.manage) even though RSVP was removed. en.js also still has dead RSVP keys (guest.rsvpTitle, rsvpYes, submitRsvp, whatsappRsvp, rsvp:{...}).

design_issues.screen: Wizard (host UI) with an Urdu card
issues: Urdu event names in host-UI labels ('Photo for مہندی', the preview event select, the event name input) render with letters split apart. Likely letter-spacing/tracking or a Latin font breaking Arabic-script joining. Use dir=auto and letter-spacing:0 for user text.
The event-name suggestion chips (Mehndi, Haldi, Nikah...) stay in English on hi/ur cards, so tapping one puts an English name on an Urdu or Hindi card.

Switching ur to hi turns the events Mehndi/Nikah/Walima into मेहंदी/विवाह/रिसेप्शन (Nikah becomes Vivah, Walima becomes Reception), which changes their meaning, not just the language. Check that this is intended.
Review rows use a fixed w-36 phone input, so the name input is very narrow and long names get cut off. Consider stacking name and phone on mobile.

The 'Invited to' chip selection stays the same after the dialog is closed and reopened, so a later CSV import quietly uses the earlier, narrower event selection. Consider resetting it on open or showing it clearly.
It uses window.confirm (a native browser dialog) instead of the shadcn AlertDialog, so it doesn't match the app design.

action_items: Rename 'Share & RSVPs' (en.js common.manage) to something like 'Share & guests', and remove the dead RSVP i18n keys
Fix how Urdu/Arabic text looks in host-UI inputs, labels and selects (dir=auto, letter-spacing 0, Nastaliq font fallback)
Optional: return 404 for an unknown guest on /sent and DELETE; return 422 for an invalid phone on guest PUT; debounce or dedupe wish saves
Optional: translate the event-name suggestion chips per card language; reset the event chips when the add-guests dialog opens; stack the review rows on mobile; replace window.confirm with AlertDialog
critical_code_review_comments: WishesSection saves the wish fire-and-forget (.catch(() => {})). The guest always sees the success message even if the save failed.
GuestCardPage fires POST /opened on every mount. React StrictMode in dev or a page refresh increases open_count (expected, but open_count counts views, not unique opens).
exportCsv calls URL.revokeObjectURL right after a.click(). This works in Chrome but can cancel the download in Safari/Firefox. Revoke it in a setTimeout instead.
Upload validation relies on the client MIME type. Add a check of the image's magic bytes.
